argv:
sh -c 'find /opt/.overlay/platform/upperdir -xdev -type f -exec sh -c '"'"'
upper=$1
lower=$2
shift 2
for path do
  rel=${path#"$upper"/}
  source="$lower/$rel"
  usize=$(stat -c %s "$path" 2>/dev/null) || usize=
  [ -n "$usize" ] || usize=ERROR
  usha=$(sha256sum "$path" 2>/dev/null) || usha=
  [ -n "$usha" ] || usha=ERROR
  usha=${usha%% *}
  if [ -f "$source" ]; then
    lsize=$(stat -c %s "$source" 2>/dev/null) || lsize=
    [ -n "$lsize" ] || lsize=ERROR
    lsha=$(sha256sum "$source" 2>/dev/null) || lsha=
    [ -n "$lsha" ] || lsha=ERROR
    lsha=${lsha%% *}
    exists=1
  else
    exists=0; lsize=NA; lsha=NA
  fi
  printf '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' "$path" "$source" "$exists" "$usize" "$usha" "$lsize" "$lsha"
done
'"'"' sh /opt/.overlay/platform/upperdir /.org_rootfs {} +'; result=$?; printf '\n__PREP_REMOTE_RC=%s\n' "$result"
